events.summary: Measured the phone layout so all three route plans are represented on screen; preserved route-map readability instead of shrinking the board blindly.
Made job-sheet ordering deterministic, declared all sheet writers and clarified read-only vehicles as ALSO CALLING HERE.
Installed a browser in CI so Toko Move browser gates actually run instead of failing before the first assertion.
Fixed hidden boarding actions, replaced fixed-duration vehicle motion with measured speeds and recalibrated the delivery target from actual route cost.
Phone pass: START SHIFT stays reachable, phones open on ROUTE and the job sheet gets more room for plan comparison.
Replaced the obsolete Mini Metro-like cabinet image with the tramstop cover that represents the current courier game.
Added player-controlled zoom, offscreen threat pips, aggregate incoming damage and clearer action readability.
Toko Live browser runtime became a CI gate.
Added the browser runtime gate for the Toko Live v44 conversation surface.
The line-drawing Mini Metro homage direction was superseded by the Central Helsinki courier game using the existing HSL network.
CHALLENGES stage-select variant mode was deliberately dropped and remains preserved only as history.
